descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S13 「医院：点 Save Note 时 Add Point 里还有没打完的草稿」 Hospital: an unfinished Add Point draft when Save Note is tapped

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. …（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient with two saved points

When Press Add Point, type a point but do not press Save Point; type a note and Save Note; reopen

Then The two saved points are unchanged; the draft text is not lost and not merged into another card

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Checkpoint, judged now: Existing A, Existing B and the draft text are all shown after Save Note (the draft is not lost). backendChecks, judged once read (oracleRules 1): A and B unchanged; the draft text kept, as a card or as the draft. Recorded for Q4: whether Save Note turned the draft into a card

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
